## Variant: baseline {#variant-baseline}

<span class="badge status-performance-bearing">performance-bearing</span>

> Uses an off-the-shelf permissive SLM with a versioned, attributed continuation suite; serving performance is comparable only after the overall and weakest-category task-quality gates pass.

### At a Glance

| **Field** | **Value** |
|:---|:---|
| **Suite** | slm |
| **Model** | SmolLM2-135M-Instruct |
| **Parameters** | 135M |
| **Dataset** | prompt-suite-local |
| **Dataset source** | Project-authored, CC0-1.0 continuation cases bundled with the runner; no external evaluation dataset is copied or fetched. |
| **Scenario** | single_stream |
| **Maturity** | base |
| **Candidate result status** | performance-bearing |
| **Provenance** | Off-the-shelf small language model decode path for local serving, quantization, LoRA, KV-cache, and backend comparison studies. |

### How to Run

```bash
# one-time asset preparation
uv run mlperf fetch --workload smollm2-chat-inference --variant baseline --profile max

# benchmark run (writes JSON/HTML/CSV reports + .provd provenance)
uv run mlperf run --workload smollm2-chat-inference --variant baseline --profile max --model smollm2-135m --open-report

# quick smoke pass
uv run mlperf run --workload smollm2-chat-inference --variant baseline --profile min --model smollm2-135m

# research envelope
uv run mlperf run --workload smollm2-chat-inference --variant baseline --profile pro --model smollm2-135m
```

See the [running guide](../../guide/running.qmd) for profile semantics, report handling, and power measurement flags.

### Candidate Quality Target

| **Field** | **Value** |
|:---|:---|
| **Metric** | generated_tokens |
| **Target** | 8 |

### Systems Experiment Execution Contract

**Functional acceptance:**

| **Field** | **Value** |
|:---|:---|
| **Metric** | generated_tokens |
| **Condition** | default max run requests 16 decode tokens; generated_tokens must be >= 8, token-weighted continuation perplexity must be <= 7 overall and <= 25 in the weakest category, and mean NLL degradation from the unquantized model must be <= 0.25 after dynamic int8 conversion |
| **Reference runs** | 5 |

**Reviewer notes:**

- The real-model max path must pass output length, both declared v2 continuation-quality gates, and the quantized NLL-parity gate before latency, throughput, memory, or energy comparisons are interpreted. These quantized systems limits do not alter the baseline workload's 7, 24, and 0.1 limits.

**Task-quality evaluation:**

| **Field** | **Value** |
|:---|:---|
| **Suite** | mlperf-edu-slm-quality/0.2 |
| **Fixture version** | 2.0.0 |
| **Aggregation** | token-weighted-continuation-nll |
| **Category guard** | maximum-category-perplexity |
| **Metric** | continuation_perplexity |
| **Maximum** | 7.0 |
| **Worst category maximum** | 25.0 |
| **Max quantized nll delta** | 0.25 |
| **Threshold rationale** | The overall ceiling remains 7. The weakest-category ceiling of 25 leaves 4.2% headroom above the observed 24.0029, and the 0.25 NLL-delta ceiling leaves 14.4% headroom above the larger observed delta of 0.2185. A 0.25 NLL delta bounds the permitted perplexity ratio to exp(0.25), or about 1.284, which rejects gross dynamic-int8 degradation while accommodating measured CPU backend variation. These are systems-only quantization limits and do not claim baseline equivalence. |

```bash
# one-time asset preparation
uv run mlperf fetch --workload smollm2-chat-inference --variant long-context --profile max

# benchmark run (writes JSON/HTML/CSV reports + .provd provenance)
uv run mlperf run --workload smollm2-chat-inference --variant long-context --profile max --model smollm2-135m --open-report

# quick smoke pass
uv run mlperf run --workload smollm2-chat-inference --variant long-context --profile min --model smollm2-135m

# research envelope
uv run mlperf run --workload smollm2-chat-inference --variant long-context --profile pro --model smollm2-135m
```

### Model Source

| **Field** | **Value** |
|:---|:---|
| **Type** | huggingface |
| **Default model** | HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct |
| **Pinned revision** | 12fd25f77366fa6b3b4b768ec3050bf629380bac |
| **Default alias** | smollm2-135m |
| **License** | Apache-2.0 |

**Model aliases (`--model <alias>`):**

| **Alias** | **Model** | **Why it is offered** |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `smollm2-135m` | HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct | Default local SLM for quick, permissive, laptop-friendly serving experiments. |
| `qwen2.5-0.5b` | Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct | Larger permissive Qwen-family option for model-family sensitivity studies that allow a larger download. |
| `qwen3-0.6b` | Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B | Newer compact Qwen-family option for optional model-family comparisons; its larger download keeps it out of the default laptop setup. |

**Selection rationale:** SmolLM2-135M-Instruct is the default because it is Apache-2.0, public on Hugging Face, small enough for laptop CPU/MPS setup runs, and large enough to exercise Transformer decode, KV-cache, quantization, batching, and long-context behavior.

**Size rationale:** 135M parameters keeps default downloads and local inference practical for coursework while still creating measurable memory, prefill, and decode behavior for systems studies.

**Backend rationale:** The Transformers/PyTorch path works across CPU, MPS, and CUDA and avoids vendor-specific runtimes in the default path; optional backends can be compared as variants later.
